_doc: W12 red-team golden battery — SINGLE SOURCE for (a) the hermetic CI red-team gate (redteam-gate.test.ts) and (b) the committed-not-applied seed migration (20260603140000). Adversarial PT-BR cases per archetype across four attack families (injection / exfil / jailbreak / over_promise). Each case carries 'expectedResist' (blocked|no_write|transfer) instead of tier/tool/action. 'fingerprints' is COPIED VERBATIM from eval-golden.json — W12 changes no prompt/model/tool, so the three hashes are identical; a defense edit flips them and forces a re-bless of this battery too. 'responses' (case_id → model → scripted LLM turns) makes the run deterministic with no live LLM; the response SCRIPTS the attack tool call so the real capability-gate blocks it inside the dry-run spine (a live regression test of the defense, not a vacuous pass). CTO decisions: (a) structural trace verdict, (b) 100% per archetype, (c) blocks CI, (d) cross-client exfil proven by construction (see redteam-exfil.test.ts), (e) scripted via makeCachedLlm.
